name: Dashel Stonefist
summary: In Old Town, Dashel Stonefist is known for his quick temper and heavy hands. The dwarf called Fist keeps to Stormwind City's rougher alleys, where dangerous connections draw the attention of covert investigators.

sections.title: A Brawler in Old Town
sections.body: In Old Town, Dashel Stonefist is known as Fist for the street fights that have earned him the name. Locals and city guards see a drunken, combative dwarf ready to throw a punch outside a tavern. His place in the district puts him at the nexus of Stormwind's underworld, where smugglers, cutpurses, and political agitators trade coin and rumors beyond the eyes of Cathedral Square.

sections.title: The Diplomat's Disappearance
sections.body: A missing diplomat draws covert royal investigators to Dashel Stonefist. Whispers of treachery lead them to the dwarf, a street-level contact for the Defias Brotherhood within Stormwind's walls. He knows about the abduction, but refuses to speak until investigators beat him into submission. What he reveals reaches deeper into the kingdom's politics than a simple kidnapping.

faq.answer: In Stormwind City's Old Town, Dashel Stonefist is a low-level cutthroat and informant in the capital's shadowy quarters. The dwarf known as Fist has a violent reputation and a habit of brawling.

faq.q: Where can I find Dashel Stonefist?
faq.answer: You can find Dashel Stonefist standing outside in Old Town, among its back alleys near the city's rogue and warrior haunts.

faq.q: Why do investigators need to fight him?
faq.answer: Investigators fight Dashel Stonefist because leads in the search for the missing royal diplomat point to him as a collaborator. Fiercely loyal to his shady employers, he respects only force and will not reveal what he knows until beaten in a bare-knuckle brawl.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist is an inside operative and messenger for the Defias Brotherhood in Stormwind. He coordinates local contacts and street muscle to conceal the Brotherhood's plans from the City Guard.

faq.q: Who is the missing diplomat connected to Dashel?
faq.answer: Royal agents pursue the story of an unnamed diplomat who vanished en route to Theramore.

faq.q: Is Dashel related to any other known dwarves?
faq.answer: No relatives of Dashel Stonefist are recorded. His criminal ties in Stormwind set him apart from reputable dwarven society.

angles.text: For rogues moving through Old Town's criminal web, Dashel Stonefist shows how an operative can talk too much once his jaw is rattled. Trusting brute muscle with delicate secrets is a poor wager.
Many Ironforge dwarves in Stormwind work as honored smiths, mountaineers, or emissaries. Stonefist shows that a dwarf can also fall into street-corner thuggery and treason.
Dashel Stonefist represents the quiet rot inside Stormwind's capital. The Defias Brotherhood's reach stretches past Westfall's farms and into the sovereign city.
